def: A picture, example, or illustration, often taken from sensibleobjects, and used to illustrate a subject; usually, an extendedmetaphor. Brande & C.
That partiality to himself by which a man overrates his ownworth when compared with others. Kames.
Agreement of words with one another, in gender, number, person,or case.
Pertaining to the stomach and diaphragm; as, the gastrophrenicligament.
The state or quality of being passionate.
A valuable kind of pear, of an obovate shape and with meltingflesh of delicious flavor; -- more properly called White Doyenné.[Written also virgaloo, vergalieu, vergaloo, etc.]
Of a dull yellowish brown color, like things tanned, or personswho are sunburnt; as, tawny Moor or Spaniard; the tawny lion. "Aleopard's tawny and spotted hide." Longfellow.
Estimated or ascertained by weight; -- distinguished fromnumeral; as, a ponderal drachma. [R.] Arbuthnot.
